title: Craft with Community — St James's Church, Harvington
body: Pop in for coffee, tea, squash and cake and a catch-up with friends and neighbours, plus colouring, making and crafts to suit all abilities, 10.30am to 12.30pm. Free, with donations gratefully received.

image.alt: Christmas-themed flyer for Craft with Community at St James's Church, Harvington: Thursday 5 November 10.30am to 12.30pm and Saturday 14 November 2 to 4pm, free event, donations gratefully received
